purpose: Selective salvage from agent/permanent-unlocks-pass-2. Only records missing from current main are retained; existing canonical rows always win by stable ID during sync.

policy.branch_rule: Do not merge the stale branch wholesale. This overlay contains only verified dependency rows not already represented in the canonical progression graph.
policy.region_rule: Keep cross-region, external and unresolved acquisition chains explicit rather than assigning a convenient final crafting or turn-in location as a hard League gate.

account_additions.name: Hard Morytania Barrows rewards
account_additions.category: regional achievement combat and reward passive
requirements: Complete the hard Morytania achievements and claim Morytania legs 3

rewards.effect: Prayer drain is halved while completing Barrows runs.
Rune rewards from Barrows chests are doubled.
Barrows chest loot can be sent directly to the bank from the reward interface.

account_additions.league_treatment: Store the achievement reward state only. Do not add Barrows strategy, kill-order or preset data to the permanent-unlock graph.

ability_additions.name: Golden Touch and Unsullied
ability_additions.dedupe_note: Limitless uses the same 2,000-vital-spark acquisition system and is already represented separately on main.
ability_additions.league_treatment: Treat the 2,000-spark requirements as base acquisition costs. League drop multipliers and access overrides remain separate modifiers.

ability_additions.name: Ingenuity of the Humans
requirements: Discover the Ingenuity of the Humans ability codex research
ability_additions.league_treatment: Do not assign a single region from the inventor's workbench. Region pressure comes from alchemical-onyx and component supply chains.

ability_additions.name: Demon, Dragon and Undead Slayer ability codices
requirements: Relevant codex blueprints from the Elite Dungeon Reward Shop
ability_additions.league_treatment: Model blueprint access, Black stone hearts, onyxes and component supply as separate dependencies. Do not collapse all three codices to one Elite Dungeon or one elective region.
